mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_participant ( settlement_id, name, is_host, token_hash, claimed_at, pay_status, reported_at, confirmed_at ) VALUES ( #{settlementId}, #{name}, #{isHost}, #{tokenHash}, #{claimedAt}, COALESCE(#{payStatus}, 'UNPAID'), #{reportedAt}, #{confirmedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, settlement_id, name, is_host, token_hash, claimed_at, pay_status, reported_at, confirmed_at FROM settlement_participant WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, settlement_id, name, is_host, token_hash, claimed_at, pay_status, reported_at, confirmed_at FROM settlement_participant WHERE id = #{id} AND settlement_id = #{settlementId}
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_participant SET token_hash = #{tokenHash}, claimed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND is_host = 0 AND token_hash IS NULL

UPDATE settlement_participant SET token_hash = NULL, claimed_at = NULL, pay_status = 'UNPAID', reported_at = NULL, confirmed_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND is_host = 0
